messages:
marisa: Quick follow-up from the UX drop: added an "undo" snackbar pattern for burst activation. Prototype: https://figma.redwood/burst-undo-v1

henry: Nice. Main ask from ops: bursts can be expensive. We need a clear undo and a short grace window so infra can rollback allocations quickly.

kevin: Accessibility notes: snackbar must be reachable by keyboard and announced to screen readers. Use `role=alert` or `aria-live=assertive` and include an `Undo` button reachable with Tab. Also provide an `Esc` shortcut to dismiss.

anna: Contrast nit: the snackbar background is light yellow with white CTA text. Fails AA. Change CTA text to dark gray or add a dark outline. Also icon contrast for the burst pill needs improving (recommend 4.5:1).

marisa: Good catches. Proposed copy for snackbar: "Temporary capacity enabled on Pool-A (+2 GPUs)." CTA: "Undo". Secondary small link: "View details". For the confirmation modal earlier we use "Enable temporary capacity" as the CTA.

henry: UX question: should Undo revert allocation immediately or schedule a graceful drain? Ops prefers an immediate deallocation request but return to previous capacity only after checking in-flight requests. We should show status: "Undo requested  Pending drain".

kevin: Announcements: when user clicks Undo, fire optimistic UI change and then announce: `aria-live=polite` "Undo requested for Pool-A; deallocating GPUs". If API fails, announce `aria-live=assertive` "Undo failed: try again" and keep Undo button enabled.

anna: Keyboard flow: focus should move to the snackbar when it appears (so users using keyboard don't miss it). But avoid focus theft for screen reader users; better approach: add a visually-focused outline on snackbar and set `aria-live=polite` announcement while keeping current focus. Provide `aria-keyshortcuts=\"Esc\"` on the snackbar close.

marisa: Hmm, conflicting patterns. Product wants immediate focus because Undo is time-limited. Maybe we can auto-focus with a short delay (300ms) and restore focus to the invoking control after snackbar times out or user dismisses. Add `prefers-reduced-motion` handling to skip auto-focus.

henry: That sounds reasonable. Also need telemetry event for `undo_shown`, `undo_clicked`, `undo_timeout`, and `undo_failed`. We should log est. cost at time of action too.

kevin: Screen reader text examples for annotations: 1) On show: `aria-live=polite`: "Temporary capacity enabled on Pool-A: +2 GPUs. Press Undo to revert." 2) On undo click: `aria-live=polite`: "Undo requested for Pool-A. Deallocating GPUs." 3) On failure: `aria-live=assertive`: "Failed to undo burst on Pool-A. Please try again."

anna: Also add a visible timer affordance in snackbar: a small countdown ring or numeric seconds. But ensure it's accessible: provide `aria-hidden=true` for the visual ring and a hidden SR-only text "This action can be undone for 10 seconds" that updates.

marisa: Copy tweak: for Snackbar summary use short tense: "Temporary capacity enabled — +2 GPUs". Tooltip for View details: "See schedule, cost estimate, and active requests".

henry: Implementation note from infra: POST /pools/{id}/burst returns a job id. Undo should call DELETE /pools/{id}/burst/{job_id} which triggers deallocation. API responds async; front-end must poll job status and surface `Pending`, `Completed`, `Failed` states.

kevin: For keyboard: when snackbar is focused, Tab should cycle to `Undo` then `View details` then `Close`. Provide ARIA role `status` for non-blocking updates and `alert` for failure. Use roving tabindex inside snackbar to keep focus management consistent.

anna: A11y checklist to add to figma notes: 1) snackbar announced (polite for success, assertive for failure) 2) Undo reachable via keyboard and SR 3) Esc closes and restores focus 4) timer SR updates 5) contrast 6) prefers-reduced-motion respected.

marisa: I'll update prototype with these annotations and change colors. Plan: 1) fix contrast and CTA color 2) add SR text snippets 3) implement auto-focus with 300ms delay and restore behavior 4) add visual timer + sr-only counter 5) add telemetry events. Pushing v2 by EOD.

devops-bot: Note: burst capacity deallocation may take up to 45s depending on GPU pool balancing. Expect `Pending` state before `Completed`.

henry: Add UI state for `Undo pending` and disable Undo while pending deallocation is in progress, then show `Reverted` when done. If failed, keep Undo enabled with `Retry` label.

kevin: Final microcopy suggestions: Undo success toast: "Temporary capacity reverted". Failure toast: "Could not revert temporary capacity. Tap Retry." Keep messages under 50 chars where possible for compact screens.

marisa: Thanks all. @kevin @anna please review the SR snippets in Figma when I push v2. @henry can you confirm API job semantics so we surface the right statuses? design-bot: design review requested: https://figma.redwood/burst-undo-v1; reviewers: @kevin @anna; due in 48h."
